Code Conjurer
Grade 10–12 · Information Technology

Java for IT learners, right in the browser.

Code Conjurer is a Java editor and a course in one. Learners write and run real Java without installing anything, and work through lesson tracks for Grades 10, 11 and 12 that follow the IEB and CAPS Information Technology curriculum, all the way to exam patterns and tips.

Create a free account Sign in

Runs in any modern browser. Nothing to install.

What learners do

Real Java, no installs

Write, run and debug Java in the browser, with keyboard input through Scanner and a variable inspector after every run.

A track for each grade

Separate lesson tracks for Grade 10, 11 and 12, each building on the last.

Practice after every lesson

Coding challenges follow each lesson, so the idea is used straight away.

Read code like an examiner

Predict-the-output and spot-the-bug quizzes train the reading skills exams test.

  • Variables and data types

  • The switch statement
  • for loops
  • while and do-while loops

Grade 11

Questions

Do learners need to install Java?

No. Code Conjurer runs Java in the browser, so it works on school computers and Chromebooks where installing software is not allowed. A keyboard makes coding much easier than a phone.

Which curriculum does it follow?

The lessons follow Information Technology for Grades 10 to 12, for both IEB and CAPS schools, and finish with the question patterns that appear in IEB exams.

How much does it cost?

Code Conjurer is one of thirteen tools on The Magic Lab. Start with a free account; full access to every tool is one plan, and schools can get a quote for all their learners and teachers.
